newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal '97 deficit may be below 2.9 pct - paper.
newsitem.headline: Portugal '97 deficit may be below 2.9 pct - paper.

text.p: Portugal's government could cut its budget deficit to below 2.9 percent of Gross Domestic Product in 1997 if tax revenues exceed expectations and costs are kept under control, a senior official was quoted as saying.

"If spending is controlled and, as it appears, tax revenues will be greater than expected, there will be a reduction in the deficit (to under 2.9 percent)," Under-Secretary for Tax Affairs Antonio Carlos Santos told Diario Economico newspaper.
The 1997 budget foresees a deficit of 2.9 percent of GDP.
